coverage_of_risk.rationale: No tests exist anywhere in app/, so none of the risky data-transformation, URL-state or sorting logic is covered by the app itself; the external acceptance suite is the only guard.

behaviour_not_implementation.rationale: There are no tests at all, so nothing asserts behaviour and nothing asserts implementation details either.

evidence: app/src/lib/queries.ts:231-296 — type-slot ordering and alternate-form (id > 10000) exclusion would silently regress with no failing test
app/src/lib/format.ts:28-33 — latestEnglishFlavor 'last en entry' semantics could be broken with no failure in app/
app/src/lib/queries.ts:149-171 — non-404 fetch errors throw with no error boundary or test to expose it
regression_power.rationale: With zero tests, any regression — even in pure functions with exact output contracts like #0025 or 0.4 m — passes the app's own (empty) suite.

evidence: app/src — no test files, no runner, no low-value tests either
signal_to_noise.rationale: No tests means no noise, but also no signal; per the anchor this scores 3.

findings.issue: The app ships with zero tests: no test script, no runner (vitest/@solidjs/testing-library), no devDependencies.
findings.suggestion: Add vitest plus @solidjs/testing-library; start with unit tests for lib/format.ts and lib/queries.ts's pure transformation logic, which need no network.

findings.issue: Pure spec-mandated helpers (humanize, dexNumber padding, formatMeasurement /10 scaling, latestEnglishFlavor, collapseWhitespace, statLabel) are completely untested despite encoding exact output contracts (#0025, 0.4 m, Sp. Atk, em dash).
findings.suggestion: Table-driven unit tests per function against spec examples (mr-mime → Mr Mime, 25 → #0025, 4 → 0.4 m, last-en flavor entry).

findings.issue: Move-table assembly (method priority map, level-up min-level dedupe, default sort level-then-name, Level column only for level-up, selectedGame fallback to highest order) is the most intricate logic in the app and untested.
findings.suggestion: Extract it as a pure function of API fixtures and unit-test method order, tie-breaking, missing-power handling and game fallback.

findings.issue: Client-side column sorting (missing-last in both directions, numeric vs string compare, aria-sort toggling) lives only in component state, not the URL, so a refactor of sortRows breaks sorting with nothing in app/ to catch it.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test sortRows directly (it's exported-able pure logic) for each column, both directions, and missing values; assert aria-sort via a component test.

findings.issue: URL filter state is untested at its edges: page clamping (?page=999), omitting default params, filter→page-1 reset, and the debounce/back-forward sync effect (lines 59-70) which has a race window while a debounce is pending.
findings.suggestion: Component tests with useSearchParams stubbed: assert URL shape after each interaction and back/forward navigation mid-debounce.

findings.issue: buildTypes' slot ordering, duplicate-entry dedupe and the id > 10000 alternate-form exclusion are untested; a subtle refactor could re-order dual-type cards or leak Mega forms into lists.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test with a small fixture type payload containing a dual-type species and an id > 10000 form.

findings.issue: fetchJson throws on non-404 errors with no error boundary anywhere, and 404s are cached as null forever in the module-level jsonCache (line 152) — never revalidated, which conflicts with 'treat the API as live'.
findings.suggestion: Add an integration test for a 500/timeout response and document or bound the 404/error caching policy.

findings.issue: The ability hidden-flag merge mutates an existing map entry in place; a Pokémon having the ability both normally and hidden sets hidden=true — subtle behaviour no test pins down.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test getAbilityPageData's pokemon assembly with a fixture containing both normal and hidden entries for the same species.

findings.issue: Selects set both the value attribute and per-option selected attributes — two redundant mechanisms whose interaction with late-rendered options is untested.
findings.suggestion: Component test asserting the correct option is selected when loading /?type=fire&generation=generation-i directly.

findings.issue: Recursive evolution-chain mapping and the nested-list renderer (app/src/routes/pokemon/[name].tsx:18-30) are untested for deep or branching chains beyond Eevee.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test evolutionNode against a three-level branching fixture.

summary: The app contains no tests of its own — no runner, no script, no test files — so all quality guarding is delegated to the external acceptance suite. The riskiest logic (spec-exact formatters, move-table assembly, client-side sorting, URL filter state, caching/error paths) is exactly the kind that pure unit tests would cover cheaply, especially lib/format.ts. Acceptance tests pass today, but any refactor of the data layer would land unverified.

untested.area: Spec-exact formatting helpers (app/src/lib/format.ts: humanize, dexNumber, formatMeasurement, latestEnglishFlavor, collapseWhitespace, statLabel)
untested.likelyBug: Off-by-one on 'last English flavor entry', wrong zero-padding (#25 vs #0025), or a scaling error in height/weight (data is decimetres/hectograms) — every page's headings and measurements render wrong.

untested.area: Move-table assembly in getPokemonPageData (app/src/lib/queries.ts:413-545): method priority, level-up min-level dedupe, default sort, selectedGame fallback
untested.likelyBug: Tables appear in wrong method order, level-up rows unsorted or duplicated, or the wrong default game selected — acceptance tests check one Pokémon's happy path, so edge cases (missing level, unknown method) slip through.

untested.area: MoveTable client-side sorting (app/src/components/MoveTable.tsx:14-30): missing-last in both directions, numeric vs string, aria-sort state
untested.likelyBug: A sortRows refactor makes missing Power sort first in one direction, compares numbers as strings, or stops updating aria-sort — silently breaks the only interactive widget on the page.

untested.area: Home URL state (app/src/routes/index.tsx:84-110, 59-70): page clamping, default-param omission, debounce/back-forward sync
untested.likelyBug: ?page=999 renders an empty list instead of clamping, back navigation mid-debounce desyncs the input from the URL, or filter changes fail to reset to page 1.

untested.area: Type/generation index building (app/src/lib/queries.ts:204-296): slot ordering, id > 10000 exclusion, species→generation mapping
untested.likelyBug: Dual-type cards show types out of slot order, Mega/alternate forms leak into lists, or species missing from a generation record get filtered out entirely instead of shown under All generations.

untested.area: Fetch layer (app/src/lib/queries.ts:149-171): non-404 error handling, 404-null caching, module-level cache invalidation
untested.likelyBug: A 500 from the API produces an unhandled server error page instead of a graceful failure, and 404s cached forever make a resource that appears later (live-data overlay) stay 'Not found' until restart.

untested.area: Ability hidden-flag merge (app/src/lib/queries.ts:439-452) and Pokémon-card 'Hidden ability' labelling
untested.likelyBug: A species with the ability both normally and hidden either loses the hidden marker or gains it on all its cards.
